cases.prompt: Inspect this project and help settle invoice-number ownership. Explain the concrete problem, offer feasible options with one justified recommendation, and ask one decision question at a time. Keep all files unchanged until I authorize saving a choice.
replies: Billing owns invoice numbering. Save that accepted ownership choice in our existing records and AGENTS.md. Defer storage separation until reporting requirements are known. No code or enforcement changes are authorized.

Resume from the saved records. Reporting can use a projection, and Import now needs independent releases. Keep Billing as the number-policy owner. Help reconsider deployment; do not choose on my behalf or edit files yet.

Adopt an independently released Import process calling the Billing numbering operation. Save this deployment choice and supersede the earlier deployment decision using our existing format. Preserve the invoice format and policy owner. Delivery protocol and storage decisions remain deferred. Do not implement code or enforcement.
review: One grounded decision question per unresolved turn, with viable options, costs and justified recommendation.
Initial audit and deployment discussion leave source and records unchanged.
Qualified ownership acceptance does not adopt storage separation or authorize implementation.
Save scoped ownership rule, exact current debt and inactive checks; preserve other project rules.
On resumption retain owner and reconsider only the changed deployment constraint.
Superseding record preserves historical rationale, links both directions and updates the active route without adopting protocol/storage choices.
